Cambridge Professor Jason Arday Found Dead Amid Plagiarism Scrutiny

Dr. Jason Arday, the youngest Black professor at Cambridge University, was found dead at age 41. His death occurred amidst scrutiny over his academic credentials and accusations of plagiarism. The Good Law Project stated on its website that Arday's death was a "direct, foreseeable and foreseen result of press harassment." UK political figures have called for reflection following the incident. A funeral fundraiser for Arday had raised over £65,000.
